[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
'''Hugh Glasgow''' was born on 8 September 1769 in East Nottingham Township, Chester County, Pennsylvania. He was the son of '''[[Glasgow-2871|John Glasgow]]''' and Mary Cranmer Glasgow.

Hugh was successful in agricultural pursuits before studying law. He was admitted to the bar and practiced law in Peach Bottom, Pennsylvania. From 1800 to 1813, he served as a judge in York County, Pennsylvania.

In 1813, he was elected as a '''Democratic-Republican''' to represent Pennsylvania's 4th congressional district in the U.S. House of Representatives. He served in the Thirteenth and Fourteenth Congresses from 4 March 1813 to 3 March 1817. Shortly after leaving Congress, he passed away at the age of 48 on 31 January 1818 in Peach Bottom, Pennsylvania. He was interred at Slate Ridge Burying Ground.

=== Family ===
Hugh Glasgow was married twice:
* '''Elizabeth "Betsy" Ramsay Glasgow''' (1774–1802)
* '''Maria "Mary" Ramsay Glasgow''' (1779–1870) (m. 1804)

He was the father of the following children:
* '''Cunningham Sample Glasgow''' (1797–1798)
* '''John Neeper Glasgow''' (1799–1873)
* '''Elizabeth "Eliza" Glasgow Neeper''' (1800–1845)
* '''James Ramsay Glasgow''' (1802–1872)
* '''Cunningham Ramsay Glasgow''' (1806–1885)
* '''Samuel Ramsay "Sample" Glasgow''' (1808–1876)
* '''William Cranmer Glasgow''' (1812–1879)
* '''Walter Franklin Glasgow''' (1815–1823)
* '''Mary Catherine Glasgow''' (1817–1817)
